## theme.svelte.ts

### `type ThemeMode`

`system` follows the OS preference.

### `type ThemeName`

The built-in named themes — each is three numbers in the stylesheet.

### `type ThemeDensity`

The theme's density step — the shared ladder, `compact` · `cozy` · `comfortable`.

### `const themes`

The named themes and the numbers behind them. Keep in sync with `@fractaldesign/fractalstyler` `src/lib/styles/colors-themes.css` — that stylesheet is the source; this list is a mirror for the picker and `theme.hue`.

### `interface ThemeSettings`

Everything a theme is. `hue`/`chroma`/`tint` are `null` until customised.

- `shape` :: The theme's corner shape — the same five words a component's `shape` takes.

### `class ThemeState`

The theme runtime: reactive settings that are written to an element (default `<html>`) as `data-*` attributes and custom properties — the stylesheet does the rest. Use the shared `theme` instance.

- `systemDark` :: What the OS asks for; updated by `initTheme`.
- `resolvedMode` :: The mode actually in effect — `system` resolved.
- `preset` :: The preset behind the current theme name.
- `customised` :: True when hue, chroma or tint override the named theme.
- `settings` :: A plain snapshot — what is persisted.
- `set` :: Merge settings in.
- `setTheme` :: Pick a named theme and drop any hue/chroma/tint override.
- `reset` :: Back to the defaults.
- `setMode` :: Switch mode. Pass the click event (or an element) to wipe the new mode in as a circle from that point, through a view transition.
- `toggleMode` :: Flip between light and dark.
- `apply` :: Write the settings to an element. `initTheme` does this reactively.

### `const theme`

The shared theme. Import it anywhere; call `initTheme()` once in the root layout.

### `interface InitThemeOptions`

- `defaults` :: Starting settings, used when nothing is stored.
- `storageKey` :: Persist to `localStorage` under this key. `false` disables persistence.

### `function initTheme`

Start the theme runtime. Call it during the root layout's initialisation: it restores stored settings, follows the OS colour scheme, and keeps `<html>` and `localStorage` in step with `theme`. Safe on the server (a no-op).

### `function themeInitScript`

A tiny blocking script for `<svelte:head>` / `app.html` that applies the stored theme before first paint, so there is no flash of the wrong mode.
